title: ph generate is a subcommand group with seven subcommands, not a flag-driven command
content:
## The canonical shape

`generate` is built with cmd-ts `subcommands({ name: "generate", cmds: { ... } })`. Seven subcommands, exactly:

`all` · `document-model` · `editor` · `app` · `processor` · `subgraph` · `migration-file`

There is **no flag-driven form**. `ph generate --editor`, `--processor`, `--subgraph`, `--drive-editor`, and `ph generate <file>.phd` are all dead; `app` is the replacement for the retired `--drive-editor` generator. Verified live forms:

```bash
ph generate all
ph generate document-model --document TodoList.phd      # -d; .phd or .json
ph generate editor        --name MyEditor --document-type my-org/todo
ph generate app           --name MyApp --document-types my-org/todo,my-org/note
ph generate processor     --name Stats --type analytics --document-types my-org/todo
ph generate subgraph      --name mySubgraph
ph generate migration-file --path ./migrations/001.ts
```

## Flag details that bite

`editor` takes **singular `--document-type` / `-t`**; `app` and `processor` take **plural `--document-types` / `-t=`** (repeatable or comma-separated). Getting the plurality wrong is the most common failure.

`processor` also takes `--type` (default `analytics`) and `--apps` (default `switchboard,connect` — whether the processor runs in Node, the browser, or both). `app` has `--disable-drag-and-drop` (default `false`).

`migration-file` is the odd one out: no `--name`, and `--path` is **required**, with `--schema-file` defaulting to `./schema.ts`.

## Three axes per subcommand

Every module subcommand supports the same triple:

- **Create new** — `--name` plus type flags, or `--document <spec.phd|.json>` to drive codegen from a Vetra spec document.
- **Re-generate existing** — `--dir <dir>` for one module, `--all` / `-a` for every module of that kind.
- **Extract** — `--extract` / `-x` inverts the command: instead of generating code it writes a spec document for each existing module into `specs/<kind>/`.

`generate all` carries only `--extract`; it otherwise re-generates every module in the project.

_Source: `clis/ph-cli/src/commands/generate.ts` plus the seven `generate-*.ts` siblings, mirrored in `apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/07-CLITooling/00-PowerhouseCLI.md`, Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: cmds are all, document-model, editor, app, processor, subgraph, migration-file. The app subcommand replaced the old --drive-editor generator.
